bodies.markdown:
这是 **Zalith-Plain Craft Launcher** 的 1.3.5 版本。

- 版本号：1.3.5

### 修复

- **微软正版登录完成后白屏、无法退出**：微软设备码页面在内嵌 WebView 中授权后经常停在白屏，刷新还会提示“我们无法满足你的需求”。现在优先交给系统浏览器完成验证（验证码自动复制），授权后直接回到启动器等待结果；关闭内置页面也不再被误判成“取消登录”。
- **`.mrpack` 整合包无法导入**：文件选择器以前只筛选 `application/zip`，而 `.mrpack` 通常被识别成 `application/octet-stream`，所以列表里根本看不到。现在可以直接选择 `.mrpack`，不再需要改成 `.zip`。
- **游戏内“编辑布局”后整屏消失**：没有布局文件时编辑器已经进入编辑态却无内容可画。现在先确保存在真实布局文件再进入编辑器，失败也只提示、不再空屏。
- **部分设备首次安装没有默认控件布局**：默认布局以前只在传统主界面初始化，直接使用 PCL2 界面启动时会漏掉；现在 PCL2 启动时也会自动补齐。
- **快捷栏宽度调整后点击切错槽位**：槽位判定改为使用触控层实际像素宽度，不再经过 Dp 换算，宽度调到多少就按多少命中。
- **版本列表偶发“Version manifest is null after all attempts”**：不再把任意 HTTP 200 当成有效清单，逐个源校验内容并自动换源；下载失败时回退本地旧清单，不再直接报错。
- **前置资源在同一个游戏版本下重复显示**：同一版本卡片里的必装前置现在合并去重，只显示一块。


### 升级

包名不变（`com.zalith.pcl`），可直接覆盖安装 1.3.4 / 1.3.x / 1.2.x；仍然不能覆盖 1.1。

This is **Zalith-Plain Craft Launcher** 1.3.5.

- Version: 1.3.5

### Fixes

- **Microsoft login ending on a blank screen**: the device-code page often stalls in the embedded WebView after authorization, and refreshing it shows "we cannot meet your request". Verification now opens in the system browser (the code is copied automatically) and the launcher keeps waiting in the background; closing the in-app page no longer cancels the login.
- **`.mrpack` modpacks could not be imported**: the picker only accepted `application/zip`, while `.mrpack` is usually reported as `application/octet-stream`. `.mrpack` can now be selected directly, no renaming required.
- **In-game "Edit layout" making the screen go blank**: the editor entered edit mode without a layout file to save to. It now ensures a real layout file exists first and reports an error instead of blanking the screen.
- **Some devices missing the default control layout after install**: initialisation only ran in the classic main screen. The PCL2 launcher now restores the default layout on startup too.
- **Hotbar switching inaccurate after changing its width**: slot hit-testing now uses the actual pixel width of the touch layer instead of a Dp round-trip.
- **Version list occasionally failing with "Version manifest is null after all attempts"**: responses are validated per source and fall back to the next one; a valid local cache is used when downloads fail.
- **Required dependencies repeated under every file of the same game version**: they are merged and de-duplicated once per version card.


### Upgrade

The package name is unchanged (`com.zalith.pcl`), so 1.3.4 / 1.3.x / 1.2.x can be updated in place. 1.1 still cannot.
